        self.v = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1))

"""

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

class NorseLIF(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size, hidden_size, output_size):
        super(NorseLIF, self).__init__()
        self.input_size = input_size
        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
        self.output_size = output_size
        self.W = nn.Parameter(torch.Tensor(hidden_size, input_size))
        self.U = nn.Parameter(torch.Tensor(hidden_size, hidden_size))
        self.V = nn.Parameter(torch.Tensor(output_size, hidden_size))
        self.b = nn.Parameter(torch.Tensor(hidden_size))
        self.tau = 50  # ms
        self.v_threshold = 1.0  # mV
        self.v_reset = 0.0  # mV
        self.I = torch.zeros(hidden_size)

    def forward(self, x):
        batch_size = x.size(0)
        self.I = self.I.repeat(batch_size, 1)
        self.v = self.v_reset.repeat(batch_size, 1)

        for t in range(50):
            self.I = self.I + self.W @ x + self.U @ self.v
            self.v = self.v + self.I / self.tau
            self.v = torch.max(self.v, self.v_threshold)
            self.v = torch.min(self.v, self.v_reset)
            self.v = self.v - self.v_threshold
            self.v = self.v * (self.v > self.v_threshold).float()

        return self.V @ self.v

# Usage

x = torch.randn(10, 100)
y = norse(x)

 The network architecture is inspired by the work of Sprecher et al. (2018) and uses the Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neuron model with a surrogate gradient.

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import numpy as np

# Define the LIF neuron model
class LIF(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim, tau=20.0, v_threshold=1.0, v_reset=0.0):
        super(LIF, self).__init__()
        self.tau = tau
        self.v_threshold = v_threshold
        self.v_reset = v_reset
        self.w = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(output_dim, input_dim))
        self.b = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(output_dim))
        self.v = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(output_dim))

    def forward(self, x):
        # Leaky integrate-and-fire neuron model
        v = self.v + self.tau * (self.w @ x + self.b)
        v = torch.clamp(v, min=0.0)
        spikes = (v > self.v_threshold).float()
        self.v = self.v_reset * (1 - spikes) + v * spikes
        return spikes

# Define the surrogate gradient function
def surrogate_grad(x):
    return torch.where(x > 0.5, 1.0, 0.0)

# Define the network architecture
class NorseNet(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_dim, output_dim):
        super(NorseNet, self).__init__()

        spikes = self.lif(x)
        return spikes
